meta.notes: Rule parameters for the 8 systems (docs/MVP_SCOPE.md §5) plus the importance rule (§9), the intent contract parameters (docs/INTENT_SCHEMA.md), and the brief assembler contract (docs/BRIEF_SPEC.md §6, iter-8). Every number here is v0.1 tunable pack data — balance changes never touch code (INV-3). Values pinned by MVP_SCOPE or EVENT_SCHEMA examples are marked with a source note.

time.notes: MVP_SCOPE §8: full day ≈ 1440 ticks; 1 hour ≈ 60 ticks; typical action 2–8 ticks (see actions.json)

position_visibility.notes: node-based model: locations are graph nodes (entities.json exits); visibility input → knowledge output, never duplicate fields (MVP_SCOPE §9). The status modifiers on perception live with the perception skill (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers — single owner); smoke_penalty feeds the perception system (iter-3)

systems.notes: SCHED-1: reads/writes annotations are data; the scheduler builds the per-tick pass order from the per_tick subset and fails loudly on write-write ambiguity without before/after hints (docs/blueprint/phase0.md §2). per_tick remains fire-only (iter-2): the iter-3 systems (knowledge transfer, crime reactions, watch rotation, expectations) are event-driven reactions dispatched from the commit door + clock-crossing rotations — not per-tick passes; states decay passes are deferred to iter-4 (task owner: docs/TASKS.md)

checks.notes: Opposed check (INTENT_SCHEMA §5): attacker total = skill base + status modifiers + d20 vs defender total; defender = the named skill of the defender entity (target / best-in-location excluding the actor) or the flat difficulty (environment); tie → defender; defender wins by ≥ failure_margin → total failure where the action distinguishes it. Skill numbers are v0.1 defaults; the difficulty column of MVP_SCOPE §7 seeds the per-action values in actions.json

relations.notes: ev_0007 pins suspicion 0→25 together with status unknown→suspect; the document-check trigger number lives with its single owner, director.hooks.possible_document_check.trigger.value (iter-4a cleanup — the former document_check_at mirror had no reader). The arrest threshold lives in crime_watch.arrest.requires_suspicion — single owner since iter-3 (the iter-2a duplicate was removed). Suspicion deltas ride the crime reactions (iter-3); the sparse pair map (P2a) seeds from entities.json pair_relations

knowledge.notes: EVENT_SCHEMA §3: rumor = transfer event with one-step fidelity decay; distortion from source incompleteness (D-007). Trusted tellers spread faster (§6 matrix). P2c (D-033): a successful talk makes the teller share their most salient novel fact — salience = importance then recency, records born on the triggering conversation excluded. Acceptance rolls d100 vs base + trust_weight*trust − teller penalty (all pack numbers); official watch briefings are always accepted (D-006 handover, not a rumor). Landed iter-3

states.notes: modifiers feed perception (checks.skills.perception.status_modifiers) and behavior; no group reputation in v0 (D-006). Attention is the distract action's target state; decay passes fire at clock-crossing beats (iter-4); reset_on_rotation axes reset to 0 for the watch participants (iter-4a); the fear alarm spike number lives with the transition layer (transitions.fire.alarm.fear_spike — single owner, iter-4a cleanup)

fire.notes: the one transition primitive (phase0 §2, Brogue promoteTile donor): a pack-declared layer — flag-gated ignition, stochastic per-tick spread within the location, SEEDED follow-ups, alarm with fear spikes. rules.json fire section restructured into this generic layer at iter-2 (same v0.1 numbers); iter-20: the follow-up vocabulary (kinds, flags, values, the spreading spot_state, the spread halt_flag) moved from core code into the layer declaration — a second pack declares its own vocabulary, zero engine edits (D-057). position_visibility.smoke_penalty stays with the perception input it belongs to

transitions.notes: generic transition engine (core/transitions.py) iterates pack-declared layers by name — core code carries no layer names and no follow-up kinds (INV-3; D-057: spot_state/halt_flag/follow_ups are layer data)

crime_watch.notes: Watch change = knowledge-transfer event between watchers (D-006); rotations fire when the clock crosses a tick in watch_rotation_ticks — the duty/rest posts swap, expectations are checked (rules.expectations), then the outgoing holder briefs the incoming one (one fidelity step down, dedup by token). The crime system reacts to KNOWLEDGE, not to actions: a novel crime-mapped token moves the knower's suspicion axis (crime_watch.suspicion_axis) by suspicion_sources delta; the crime-status flip (entities crime_status → status_suspect_value) rides the first crossing of relations.suspicion_thresholds.status_suspect_at — the ev_0007 shape on the reacting system. Novel tokens only: repeated evidence with the same token never re-escalates (escalation is the pack's token vocabulary). Crossing arrest.requires_suspicion co-located with the suspect emits the arrest attempt (a fact; iter-4 resolves it via arrest.resolution_check evasion vs pursuit — caught_value flips the suspect's crime_status irreversibly, T4). figure_at_back_door_last_night maps for the §3 drunkard rumor (autonomous telling arrives iter-4). Landed iter-3; arrest resolution added iter-4

expectations.notes: P2d (KI#3): behaviour rules generate per-NPC expectations; a mismatch at check time emits an inferred-channel record cause-chained to the event that moved the item on the violated axis — the only legal route to suspicion-from-absence (an absence is knowable only as a violated expectation, never as 'not seen'). carried_by expectations check anywhere (their own pocket); at_location expectations additionally require the NPC on site. Checked at watch rotations (v0.1); rules must hold on the initial pack state (load-time lint). Landed iter-3

entries.notes: the drunkard lingers — a small-formula nudge toward ale-seeking; the §3 walkthrough's rumor teller needs to be in-scene to overhear
the maid finishes her shift — a low-key rest; her presence at the tavern keeps the sighting pool rich
the relief guard's patrol impulse — fires when something is happening in the actor's location (the precondition is a placeholder for ambient alertness; v0.1)

urgencies.notes: P2b (D-021): NPC goals → occasional autonomous action through the same queue, same tick discipline. Small-formula dynamics: a probability roll per beat, an intent template, optional preconditions. World acts without the PC by construction — M5 (non-PC event share) becomes non-trivially non-zero at director-off (T8). Full LLM planning — never (VISION §6). Beat cycle at phase boundaries (every 360 ticks = 6 in-world hours); the same beats carry the states decay pass and the director's entropy release (one beat, three pieces — D-037). Landed iter-4

guard_suspicious_of_pc.notes: the watcher grows wary — a low-key vigil; seeded on a steal failure (hooks.failure in actions.json steal)

possible_document_check.notes: the document-check deferred consequence (MVP_SCOPE §11): released when the watcher's suspicion crosses 50 (relations.suspicion_thresholds.document_check_at). v0.1 stub intent: the full document_check action is a phase-3 refinement.

director.notes: D-005: the director releases already-seeded consequences; a complication from nowhere is a bug. P2e (narrative entropy) replaces the v0.1 flat timer: entropy = sum(seeded-hook weights) + global suspicion + visible physical threats (observable state only, L6). Stagnation releases the lowest-threshold hook when entropy < floor (a tension floor sensor). Explicit triggers (time / place / threshold) fire causally regardless of entropy. Per-NPC cooldown (MinGapBetweenEncounters analogue) prevents targeting spam. Director-off (T8 A/B baseline) = buffer still seeds, nothing releases — the world's emergent chains come from urgencies + reactions. Per-run scope: the buffer reseeds from the log every run (fold of events); policies are pack data. The director never learns the player (Alien named negative). Landed iter-4

importance.notes: MVP_SCOPE §9: computed from entities touched + irreversibility + far hooks → low/medium/high; never by feel. Mapping thresholds are v0.1 defaults

metrics.notes: iter-6: event type → systems touched (M1 cross-system share). Pack data (INV-3 — system names are MVP_SCOPE §5 mechanic words, not setting nouns; FAQ note in STATUS.md). The state_change prop-prefix → system map lives in core/metrics.py (closed set of mechanic prefixes: position / relations / status / fire / pair / crime_status). intent_rejected is the front-door no-op event — no system touched by construction.

directives: Narrate only what the brief contains; the log is the canon.
Facts are immutable; prose is yours.
Never invent events, names, or outcomes.

lore.text: The tavern stands on the old salt road; carts stop rarely since the bridge toll rose.
The watch answers to the tollmaster's charter: two guards, one duty post, no questions after dark.

voice_exemplars: The taproom hummed, low and careless, the way rooms do before anything happens.
Rain started against the shutters — a patient, unhurried sound.
